signal: Nextech rolled out new eyecare innovations including AI-driven charting and an Ocuco optical integration, after back-to-back Best in KLAS wins.

email.body1:
Britney, saw Nextech shipped AI-driven charting and the Ocuco optical integration on the back of consecutive Best in KLAS wins.

Momentum like that usually means more in-market practices in your region than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Britney, quick follow-up for Nextech.

As a regional sales lead you feel coverage pressure first: more specialty practices in the territory than reps can reach in a quarter. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit the regional number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Britney, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your region's reply rate likely compares to peer healthcare-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Britney, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Carrying a region while new products roll out is plenty to juggle.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your territory motion? I will tailor it to Nextech either way.
